summary:
Iteration 497 SEAL regression — iter 483-496 modules verified end-to-end. Backend pytest: 18/18 PASSED. Frontend Playwright: all critical flows verified (login/nav Simple↔Pro, favorites persistence, dept-shortcuts-sidebar, /book damage-waiver checkbox → summary row + total update, GroupDisplacementPanel admin UI, DepartmentShortcutsPanel admin UI, MobileHome dept cards, MyHotelBox+ReveniQ landings). No critical console errors (2 non-blocking 401 on login page for pre-auth resource fetch — carried from iter 485).

COVERED:
  ✓ AUTH: admin login, /auth/me, wrong-password rejection (401)
  ✓ ONBOARDING iter 483: quick-start on temp property (3 rooms + 2 rate plans + 1 tax + 15 demo bookings), idempotent (2nd call created 0 rooms), drip status/enroll/run-now (mock success), preview/welcome HTML
  ✓ NAV iter 485/487: nav-mode-simple/pro toggle, mhb_nav_mode persists after reload, favorites (fav-toggle-dashboard → favorites-section) persist across reload via mhb_favorites
  ✓ DEPT SHORTCUTS iter 488/489: GET all + management dept, PUT management (saved test list + restored original [dashboard, tier1-dashboard, revenue, finance, analytics, team]), badges/default returns arrivals/housekeeping/my-tasks counts, dept-shortcuts-sidebar visible for admin, dept-shortcuts-btn admin panel with 7 tabs (Ön Büro, Yönetim, Housekeeping, F&B, Teknik, Spa, Concierge) + arama
  ✓ GROUP DISPLACEMENT iter 490-492: /analyze KABUL (10 rooms @ 300 = net-positive accept) and RED (18 @ 50 = reject with suggested_min_rate>50), 3-night per_night breakdown, breakeven correct, /history + /verdicts endpoints work, group-displacement-btn admin form + history cards (net -720 REDDET, net 1800 KABUL) visible
  ✓ DAMAGE PROTECTION iter 493-496: config GET/PUT, claim lifecycle (open→approved auto-fill approved_amount=amount→settled with partial), stats math (net_pool=collected-paid ✓), PUBLIC /booking/damage-waiver/default returns enabled+fee, /book?property=default flow: search→reserve→damage-waiver-checkbox → summary-damage-waiver 'Hasar koruması £6' → total £240→£246, POST /booking/reserve with damage_waiver:true adds fee (£6 for 2 nights × £3), owner-pulse digest preview contains Hasar/damage/waiver content
  ✓ CORE regression: dashboard KPI hero + tiles, Pro mode 14 sections, mobile MobileHome mobile-dept-section with cards, MyHotelBox + ReveniQ landings load

CLEANUP: Temp property TEST_ITER497_* + related (property_onboarding, onboarding_drip, room_types, rate_products, tax_profiles, bookings) cleaned via test_zzz_cleanup. Damage claims + waivered temp bookings on 'default' deleted. UI panel-created group displacement analyses (Kongre Grubu, Test Tur) also cleaned. Original 'default' property + management dept shortcuts restored to spec [dashboard, tier1-dashboard, revenue, finance, analytics, team]. Damage protection config kept enabled=true (default state expected by tests).
critical_code_review_comments: damage_protection.attach_waiver uses $set + $inc on total_price in same update — Motor/PyMongo supports this but requires no overlapping fields; safe here since damage_waiver/damage_waiver_fee are separate from total_price. OK.

damage_protection.stats considers 'settled' claims for paid but 'open'/'under_review' for pending — 'approved' but not yet 'settled' claims (with approved_amount set) don't hit paid nor pending. Minor accounting nuance; not a bug for MVP.
group_displacement._adr_on ignores rooms>1 pricing for total_price/nights/rooms — correct division. OK.
onboarding-drip/run-now is global (no property scope) — process_due_drips iterates all enrolled properties. Test-friendly but a per-property run-now could be helpful for admin UI. Non-blocking.
/book page shows chat widget that keeps network active — using domcontentloaded (per playbook) works. Already documented.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (login, nav toggle+persist, favorites+persist, dept-shortcuts sidebar+admin, /book damage-waiver full flow, GroupDisplacement panel, mobile MobileHome, landings)

seed_data_creation: Temp property TEST_ITER497_<uuid> created + 3 demo bookings for waiver test (all deleted at end). UI-created 'Kongre Grubu' + 'Test Tur' group_displacement_analyses deleted.
context_for_next_testing_agent: iter 483-496 all green. Backend suite runnable standalone: pytest backend/tests/test_iteration497_seal_regression.py. Damage protection config on 'default' is enabled=true, fee_per_night≈3.0 GBP — required for /book flow tests. management dept shortcuts restored to [dashboard, tier1-dashboard, revenue, finance, analytics, team]. Note quick-start requires body {} even though all fields optional (Pydantic model required). Public /book damage-waiver flow VERIFIED end-to-end on preview.
rca of the issue: No functional bugs found. Initial test failures were script errors (missing body {} on quick-start/enroll, and rooms endpoint returning list not object) — fixed. Two pre-existing 401 console messages on login page carried from iter 485 (non-blocking, likely branches/notifications endpoint being fetched before auth completes).
